description:
Other lines for Flood, State of Palestine, 28 August 2025 (FL20250828PSE): 96 features merged from 6 source layers. Lines layers that match none of the named groups. The source layer names below say what each holds. The `source_layer` and `source_file` columns name the layer and file each row came from. The geometry is in EPSG:32636, the CRS of the source layers; the PMTiles copy is in Web Mercator.

From these HDX datasets:

- [Sea Surge risk & flood impact assessment in the Coastal Area of Gaza city (Occupied Palestinian Territory) as of 29 August 2025](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/sea-surge-risk-flood-impact-assessment-in-the-coastal-area-of-gaza-city-occupied-palestini)
- [Sea Surge risk & flood impact assessment in the Coastal Area of Southern Gaza Strip (Occupied Palestinian Territory) as of 29 August 2025](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/sea-surge-risk-flood-impact-assessment-in-the-coastal-area-of-southern-gaza-strip-occupied)

Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the columns and query recipes.

table:columns.name: Shape_Length
table:columns.description: Computed by ArcGIS in the units of the source layer's CRS (degrees for EPSG:4326), so it is not a metric measure.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, as UNOSAT published it (not repaired).

table:columns.name: source_layer
table:columns.description: Name of the layer in the source file that this row came from.

table:columns.name: source_file
table:columns.description: Name of the file downloaded from HDX that this row came from.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the geometry (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax), added for spatial filtering.
